checks.title: Model output flows to eval/exec/shell/SQL sinks (partial SQL coverage)
checks.expected_secure_behavior: Model output is treated as untrusted: it is parsed against a schema and mapped to allowlisted actions, never executed or concatenated into queries.
checks.remediation: Remove eval/exec/shell use of model output; parse structured output, map to an allowlist of actions and use parameterised queries.

owasp: OWASP LLM Top 10 2025: LLM05 Improper Output Handling

checks.title: MCP/agent config with launchers not pinned to an exact version, broad filesystem roots or inline tokens
checks.expected_secure_behavior: MCP servers launched via npx/uvx are pinned to an exact version or immutable ref (version ranges and dist-tags such as ^1.2, >=1, latest, next are not pins), scoped to a project directory and receive credentials from the environment, not the file.
checks.remediation: Pin packages to exact versions (name@1.2.3 or name==1.2.3) or a commit SHA, restrict filesystem roots to the project directory, and reference secrets via environment variables; rotate any exposed token.

owasp: OWASP LLM Top 10 2025: LLM03 Supply Chain
OWASP LLM Top 10 2025: LLM06 Excessive Agency

checks.title: Agent tools enabling shell/Python REPL/dangerous code without approval or sandbox marker
checks.expected_secure_behavior: Agents get least-privilege tools; shell or code execution is gated by human approval or runs in an isolated sandbox/container without secrets, within the same function that wires the tool.
checks.remediation: Remove dangerous tools or gate them with human approval or a sandbox; disable allow_dangerous_code and dangerouslyAllowBrowser.

owasp: OWASP LLM Top 10 2025: LLM06 Excessive Agency

checks.title: Model artifact loading: trust_remote_code=True, pickle-family or unsafe torch.load of downloaded data
checks.expected_secure_behavior: Models load from non-executable formats (e.g. safetensors) or torch.load(weights_only=True) on PyTorch >= 2.6.0, remote code is disabled or pinned to a reviewed 40-hex revision, and pickle-based artifacts are only loaded from integrity-checked trusted sources.
checks.remediation: Remove trust_remote_code=True or pin a reviewed revision; prefer safetensors; use torch.load(weights_only=True) on a patched PyTorch (>= 2.6.0); verify hashes of downloaded artifacts and never unpickle untrusted data.

owasp: OWASP LLM Top 10 2025: LLM03 Supply Chain

checks.title: Prompt injection and indirect injection evaluation
checks.expected_secure_behavior: Untrusted content cannot cause the model to override instructions, call unintended tools or exfiltrate data.
checks.remediation: Separate trusted instructions from untrusted data, restrict tool permissions, filter outputs, and run a repeatable injection suite against an authorized environment.

owasp: OWASP LLM Top 10 2025: LLM01 Prompt Injection

checks.title: RAG data-boundary and tenant isolation test
checks.expected_secure_behavior: Retrieval is filtered by the caller's tenant and entitlements so no cross-tenant content can be retrieved or cited.
checks.remediation: Enforce tenant/ACL filters at the vector store query layer, test with multi-tenant canary documents and log retrieval provenance.
